claim: A generic eight-harmonic period profile, selected without using the DERD recurrence score, places the OGLE-LMC-CEP-0010 optimum within 2.84 parts per million of the catalog period and does not rescue the target from the frozen harmonic gate.
interpretation: The gate failure is not caused by a large hypothesis-tuned period shift. This is one exposed target, not a population result.
method: generic weighted harmonic chi-square profile independent of the DERD score
